agents.name: Ambiguity Detector
agents.purpose: Detect ambiguous language (e.g., 'reasonable efforts', 'material', 'substantially') and propose concrete rewrite options.

agents.name: Citation Verifier
agents.purpose: Verify every major finding is traceable to specific chunks; flag gaps and weak evidence.

agents.name: Clause Analyzer
agents.purpose: Extract canonical clause types (termination, liability, indemnity, confidentiality, payment, governing law, dispute resolution) with citations.

agents.name: Compliance Checker
agents.purpose: Check the extracted clauses against generic policy notes and flag missing/weak protections; ensure findings are evidence-grounded.

agents.name: Contract Parser
agents.purpose: Normalize raw legal text, preserve headings, and produce a stable structured representation for downstream extraction.

agents.name: Contradiction Detector
agents.purpose: Detect internal conflicts between clauses and definitions; produce evidence-linked contradiction reports.

agents.name: Definition Indexer
agents.purpose: Build a glossary of defined terms; flag missing, circular, unused, or inconsistent definitions.

agents.name: Hallucination Guard
agents.purpose: Red-team the draft outputs; detect unsupported claims and force corrections to align strictly with document evidence.

agents.name: Jurisdiction Checker
agents.purpose: Validate governing law / venue / dispute resolution consistency; flag mismatches and enforcement risks.

agents.name: Liability Stress Tester
agents.purpose: Stress-test limitation of liability vs indemnity/warranty/termination; flag cap too low, carve-outs missing, or asymmetry.

agents.name: Missing Clause Detector
agents.purpose: Identify expected clause categories that are absent or under-specified given the document type; generate targeted questions.

agents.name: Negotiation Advisor
agents.purpose: Turn risks into negotiation moves: redlines, fallback language, questions to ask, and recommended positions.

agents.name: Obligation Extractor
agents.purpose: Extract obligations by party (Supplier/Customer/Mutual) and map each obligation to evidence chunks.

agents.name: Review Pack Assembler
agents.purpose: Assemble a final review pack (inventory, risks, contradictions, rewrites, negotiation playbook) with consistent structure.

agents.name: Risk Classifier
agents.purpose: Assign severity/likelihood/impact for clause-level risks with rationale; convert into a structured risk register.

agents.name: Segmenter
agents.purpose: Split normalized document into stable chunk IDs for traceability and citation alignment.

agents.name: Style Enforcer
agents.purpose: Enforce concise formatting and eliminate duplication; ensure the review pack is skimmable and decision-ready.

agents.name: Summary Generator
agents.purpose: Generate an executive summary and decision-ready bullet points derived from verified findings, including key risks and next actions.
